DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma.

The ultrasound showing a cystic mass in the subhepatic region with dilation of the bile ducts, combined with your painless jaundice, weight loss, and smoking history, is highly indicative of a malignancy in the bile ducts. We have sufficient clinical evidence to proceed with this diagnosis.
